beats.say: Anthropic's formal-math repository now contains a machine-checked proof that VP is not equal to VNP over every field.
For every field, circuits for the Hamiltonian cycle polynomial, and for the permanent outside characteristic 2, need more than m^(c^) gates for all large m.
The same holds for approximating circuits. The result was discovered by an internal research Claude model. Both were written by AI models, and no human mathematician has checked the proof.
